meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务的计划、发现与进度写进磁盘文件,中断后能接着干
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多到一次对话装不下,又怕中途中断要从头再来。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task has too many steps for one session and losing progress would hurt.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 把任务计划、发现和进度写进项目里的三个 markdown 文件(task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md),当作磁盘上的工作记忆,做完一步就更新,这样上下文丢失或 /clear 之后工作还能接着做。
howto.when: 当你要规划、拆解或整理一个多步骤项目、研究任务,或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发;也可以直接调用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我把这个多步骤任务拆成计划,写成 task_plan.md
say.note: 它会在项目里建计划文件并分阶段推进

say.text: 把刚才的调研发现整理进 findings.md
say.note: 它会写入 findings.md 保存结论

say.text: 我 /clear 了,接着上次的计划继续做
say.note: 会话恢复会读取本项目的计划文件

howto.what_en: Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md on disk in your project as working memory, updating them as it works so progress survives context loss and /clear.
howto.when_en: Use when asked to plan out, break down or organize a multi-step project or research task, or any work needing 5+ tool calls.

say_en.text: Break this multi-step task into a plan in task_plan.md
say_en.note: It creates the plan file and tracks phases

say_en.text: Save what you just found into findings.md
say_en.note: It writes the findings to findings.md

say_en.text: I ran /clear, continue from the existing plan
say_en.note: Recovery reads this project's plan files
